findings.text: The main decode entry consumes caller supplied bytes or pulls a single byte from the guest stream, establishes default operation and address widths from the current execution mode, walks legacy markers, resolves extension and vector prefixes, selects a descriptor through primary and extended tables plus group indirection, screens control flow enforcement and feature eligibility, decodes address components and three operands, repairs register relative addresses, and reports success or failure while flagging propagated faults.

Prefix scanning loops over size overrides and segment overrides and lock and repeat markers and sixty four bit extension bytes, discarding prior extension state when a legacy marker follows it. After the loop the operation width widens when the wide bit is present, then the leading byte chooses among vector handling with fallback to legacy descriptor forms and two or three byte maps and the primary map.

Default widths depend on mode with descriptor driven promotion for real and virtual eighty six forms and narrow widths for sixteen bit protected form and wide widths for thirty two bit protected form and split widths for sixty four bit form. Size markers toggle between paired widths with distinct pairing inside and outside sixty four bit form.

A helper translates an abstract operand selector into a concrete operand shape. Register selectors yield register references and several immediate selectors yield unsigned or signed values from narrow to full width and accumulator selectors target fixed accumulators with byte sensitivity and string selectors synthesize memory references anchored at fixed string registers with suitable segments and the translation selector combines two fixed registers under address masking and far selectors capture extended pointer length and segment selectors yield constant segment identities and implicit or unknown selectors suppress result retention. Memory forms share a path that snapshots the current memory template and records the destination for later repair and optionally expands bit addressing and preserves the initial value.

Vector prefix handling rejects any prior legacy size or repeat or extension state and expands the short form into long form fields and inverts polarity bits and derives extension bits with map and vector selectors and requires sixty four bit form when extension bits are present. It selects the descriptor from the indicated map while treating one map as unhandled and rejects nonzero vector source selectors and sets the operation width to one of two vector lengths and then synthesizes size or repeat state from the encoded prefix field.

Decode refuses to proceed when control flow enforcement is active in the host control register and either shadow stack or branch tracking enablements are present in the relevant user or supervisor configuration for instructions classified as affecting those mechanisms. Far transfers consult both privilege configurations while near transfers consult only the current privilege level, and configuration access failures also refuse emulation.

After group resolution the routine records branch character and rejects empty descriptors and vector prefixes lacking vector annotation while defaulting their alignment, then applies width corrections for stack and near branch forms in sixty four bit mode and for width dependent forms and for forms forbidding narrow width and for vector and media extensions, while capturing permission and intercept callbacks for later phases.
A predicate exposes whether the decoded descriptor carries the page table update marker, allowing callers to identify instructions that modify paging structures.

A helper reports completion of repeating string compare and scan operations by combining the current operation identity with the repeat flavor and the zero condition, returning completion when the repeat flavor contradicts the observed zero condition.

The execution entry validates lock eligibility and far source shape and enforces sixty four bit exclusions and undefined markers and checks numeric extension availability and operating system support for vector and media states plus task switched state. It flushes pending numeric faults and materializes media operands when needed and performs ordered intercept consultations before and after permission and memory stages and enforces protected mode and privilege requirements with distinct fault kinds. It evaluates repeat counts with register quirks and reads memory sources and destinations with write access fault promotion and manages repeat status flags and dispatches either through a registered handler or through single byte operation logic covering conditional branches and address computation and exchange and sign extension and software interrupts and jumps and halt and flag manipulation, then retains source updates.

Initialization clears address relativity and extension prefix state and lock state and size and repeat markers and register validity and dirtiness tracking and input output and memory read cursors, ensuring conditionally set fields have deterministic values.
A numeric state helper enters protected floating point context and issues a wait operation to surface deferred errors and exits the context and converts any failure into a numeric fault exception.
A small helper conditionally refreshes an operand from the media register file only when the operand kind indicates media storage.

The media register accessor guards the raw read with acquisition and release of floating point context. The raw variant selects among eight media registers and treats any other index as a fatal programming error.
Escape group decoding bounds the high table index with a speculation hardened array index primitive before dereferencing, limiting transient out of bounds access.

Default operation and address widths in bytes are two and two for real and virtual eighty six forms without promotion and for sixteen bit protected form, four and four for thirty two bit protected form and for promoted real forms, and four and eight for sixty four bit form. Size markers toggle between two and four outside sixty four bit form and between four and eight for addresses inside sixty four bit form.

Legacy marker values in decimal are operand size override one hundred two and address size override one hundred three and segment overrides thirty eight and forty six and fifty four and sixty two and one hundred and one hundred one and lock two hundred forty and repeat flavors two hundred forty two and two hundred forty three and extension range from sixty four through seventy nine valid only in sixty four bit form. Vector leading values are one hundred ninety six and one hundred ninety seven and the two byte escape is fifteen with extended selector fifty six.
Operation widths for vector forms are sixteen bytes for short vectors and thirty two bytes for long vectors, with sixteen bytes for streaming extension forms and eight bytes for media forms.
The media register file holds eight entries indexed zero through seven.
Media and numeric paths acquire floating point context before raw register or wait operations and release it afterwards, with paired acquisition around each guarded section.

The emulation context aggregates execution mode and operation and address widths and prefix state and opcode identity and length and descriptor flags and address decoding scratch and three operand slots plus shared memory template and fixup pointer and fetch cursors and exception and intercept state with callbacks. Each operand carries a kind tag and byte length and address variant for register or segmented memory or immediate and current and original values with auxiliary count and value pointers.
